headline_hook: Glasswing Delivers, NVIDIA Rethinks Text Generation, and Every Lab Ships Agents

pick_of_the_day.thesis: The simultaneous pivot from model labs to agent labs isn't a coincidence — it's an industry-wide admission that raw capability has hit diminishing returns and the real value layer is orchestration, not parameters.

model_literacy.relevance: NVIDIA's Nemotron generates all tokens simultaneously instead of one-by-one — understanding how diffusion applies to text (not just images) explains why this could break the autoregressive speed ceiling.

items.title: Tencent Ships 1.8B Translation Model That Runs on Your Phone
items.angle: The Hy-MT2 family now spans 1.8B to 30B — the small end is edge-deployable across 33 languages, giving enterprises a private translation option.

items.title: Claude Code 2.1.149 Drops 26 CLI Changes
items.angle: The meatiest update in weeks: /usage cost breakdowns, PowerShell security hardening, and a bash find stability fix that was biting power users.

items.title: Gemini Omni Doesn't Just Generate Video — It Edits It Natively
items.angle: True multimodality means Gemini can edit existing footage, not just generate from scratch — the 1896 train film demo shows a workflow no other model offers.
items.key_fact: Native video editing via full multimodal architecture, not a generation pipeline

items.title: Turn Your Repeated Agent Prompts Into Reusable Skills
items.angle: Meta-optimization that compounds: ask Codex to extract recurring prompt patterns into skills and subagents so you stop repeating yourself.
items.key_fact: Codex can analyze past sessions to auto-generate reusable skills

items.title: A Practitioner's Model Picker: Opus for Frontend, GPT 5.5 for Backend
items.angle: Production-tested model recommendations across 8 categories — cuts through benchmark noise with what actually works in real codebases.
items.key_fact: Opus 4.7 for frontend, GPT 5.5 xHigh for backend, Flash 3.5 for vision

items.title: Project Glasswing Publishes Its First Cybersecurity Findings
items.angle: Anthropic's collaborative AI cybersecurity initiative moves from press release to technical results — the methodology for cross-lab threat intelligence sharing is the real story.
items.key_fact: First detailed technical findings from multi-lab cybersecurity collaboration

items.title: NVIDIA's Nemotron Generates All Tokens at Once With Diffusion
items.angle: Diffusion-based language models skip the one-token-at-a-time bottleneck entirely — NVIDIA's architecture details and benchmarks show this isn't theoretical anymore.
items.key_fact: Simultaneous token generation via diffusion, with published benchmarks

items.title: Ganguli's Framework for Unifying Physics, Neuroscience, and AI
items.angle: LeCun-boosted paper proposes a cross-disciplinary science of intelligence — could reshape how we think about architectures beyond transformers.
items.key_fact: Unified framework across physics, neuroscience, and AI

items.title: Antigravity 2.0 Tops the First 3D Architecture LLM Benchmark
items.angle: A new OpenSCAD benchmark measures LLMs on 3D architectural generation — the capability gap between text generation and physical-world design is narrowing.
items.key_fact: Google's Antigravity 2.0 leads new OpenSCAD architectural benchmark

items.title: Every Model Lab Is Now an Agent Lab — and That Changes Everything
items.angle: Latent Space crystallizes the week's pattern: Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, and Alibaba are all shipping agent products. The competitive axis has shifted from benchmarks to workflows.
items.key_fact: All major labs now ship agent products, not just models

items.title: The Unsolved Agent Problem: What Happens When It Needs to Move Money?
items.angle: Tool calling is solved. Financial transactions are not. The trust infrastructure gap for agents handling payments, invoices, and transfers is the real bottleneck.
items.key_fact: No clean standard for agent financial transactions exists

items.title: Specialization Beats Scale — But Most Procurement Ignores It
items.angle: Smaller fine-tuned models outperform frontier APIs on specific enterprise tasks — the buy-vs-build math changes when you measure task performance, not benchmarks.
items.key_fact: Specialized smaller models outperform general frontier models on specific tasks

items.title: DeepMind Expands Singapore AI Partnership for Science and Healthcare
items.angle: A concrete template for national-level AI deployment with safety guardrails — pandemic prep, drug discovery, and healthcare at government scale.
items.key_fact: Expanded partnership covers scientific discovery, pandemic preparedness, healthcare

items.title: CodeWhale Brings Claude Code-Style Agents to DeepSeek Models
items.angle: 33K+ stars for a terminal coding agent that runs on DeepSeek — massive demand for local-first, open-model agent workflows is real.
items.key_fact: 33,856 GitHub stars, runs DeepSeek models locally in terminal

items.title: Simon Willison Ships Datasette Agent for Conversational Data Exploration
items.angle: An AI agent that autonomously explores and queries databases via Datasette — plugin-extensible and immediately useful for interrogating unfamiliar data.
items.key_fact: Alpha release, plugin-extensible, works with any Datasette instance

items.title: Kakuna: Agent Skills That Only Know How to Harden Your Code
items.angle: The 'maintenance factory' concept: point Kakuna at a repo and it returns hardened code plus an audit trail. Agents doing the boring-but-critical work.
items.key_fact: Focused agent skills for automated codebase hardening with audit output
